data: V iskanju najboljše fotografije za šolsko tekmovanje se štirje najstniki podajo v oddaljeno hribovje. Tekmovanje za nagrado se spremeni v boj za preživetje. Zgodba o odraščanju, ljubezni, prijateljstvu in junaštvu. Topel, a napet in mestoma srhljiv film se osredotoča na to, kaj se zgodi v današnjem svetu, ko tehnologija zataji in pridejo na plan "primarni" človeški instinkti. (19-year-old Moritz and Hannes have been best friends ever since they were kids. Everything changes the day Hannes is the victim of a motorcycle accident and falls into a coma. Moritz is convinced that his friend will wake up soon.)

19-year-old Moritz and Hannes have been best friends ever since they were kids. Everything changes the day Hannes is the victim of a motorcycle accident and falls into a coma. Moritz is convinced that his friend will wake up soon.
